## Selector Conflict Analysis

### Row 1: Hero Title Element

| Rule Source | Selector | Specificity | Applied | Does It Match? | Issue |
|-------------|----------|-------------|---------|----------------|-------|
| landing-shared.css:77 | `.landing-hero-content > h1` | 0,1,1 | YES | NO ❌ | Element is `.landing-hero-text > h1`, not direct child |
| landing-shared.css:87 | `.hero-text h1` | 0,1,1 | NO | NO ❌ | Element is inside `.landing-hero-text`, not `.hero-text` |
| landing-hero-text.css:12 | `.landing-hero-text .landing-hero-title` | 0,2,1 | YES ✓ | YES ✓ | CORRECT: Matches nested h1 |
| LandingAWS.css:56 | `.hero-text h1` | 0,1,1 | NO | NO ❌ | Same as landing-shared, doesn't match |

**Result:** `.landing-hero-text .landing-hero-title` applies (from landing-hero-text.css), BUT:
- NO `grid-column: 1 / -1` rule → Title stays in column 1 only
- NO full-width styling from landing-shared.css

|-------------|----------|-------------|---------|----------------|-------|

| Rule Source | Selector | Specificity | Applied | Does It Match? | Issue |
|-------------|----------|-------------|---------|----------------|-------|
| landing-shared.css:125 | `.landing-hero-content > div:last-child` | 0,1,2 | NO* | MAYBE* | Works if `.landing-hero-buttons` is last child, but fragile selector |

**Result:** `.landing-hero-buttons` matches from landing-hero-buttons.css:

- `.hero-cta` rules in LandingAWS.css are ORPHANED (never used)

## The Core Problem: HTML Structure Mismatch

### What landing-shared.css Expects (Old Structure):
```html
<div class="landing-hero-content">
  <div class="hero-text">
    <h1>Title</h1>
    <p class="hero-subtitle">Subtitle</p>
    <p class="hero-description">Description</p>
  </div>
  <div class="hero-icon">...</div>
  <div class="hero-cta">
    <!-- buttons here -->
  </div>
</div>
```

### What Components Actually Render (New Structure):
```html
<div class="landing-hero-content">
  <div class="landing-hero-text">
    <h1 class="landing-hero-title">Title</h1>
    <p class="landing-hero-subtitle">Subtitle</p>
    <p class="landing-hero-description">Description</p>
  </div>
  <div class="hero-icon">...</div>
  <div class="landing-hero-buttons">
    <!-- buttons here -->
  </div>
</div>
```

**Differences:**
1. `.hero-text` → `.landing-hero-text` (parent class changed)
2. `h1` (no class) → `h1.landing-hero-title` (h1 has class)
3. `p.hero-subtitle` → `p.landing-hero-subtitle` (class name changed)
4. `.hero-cta` → `.landing-hero-buttons` (wrapper class changed)

**Result:** Almost NO selectors from landing-shared.css match the rendered HTML!

---

## Specificity Cascade Order

When multiple rules match, CSS applies them in order:

1. **landing-shared.css** (imported first in typical setup)
   - `.hero-text h1` (doesn't match)
   - `.hero-subtitle` (matches but wrong context)
   - Relevant grid rules: NONE for `.landing-hero-text`

2. **landing-hero-text.css** (component styles)
   - `.landing-hero-text .landing-hero-title` ✓ MATCHES
   - `.landing-hero-text .landing-hero-subtitle` ✓ MATCHES
   - Relevant grid rules: NONE

3. **LandingAWS.css** (page-specific styles)
   - `.hero-text h1` (doesn't match)
   - `.hero-subtitle` (matches, same specificity as landing-shared)
   - Relevant grid rules: NONE

4. **Inline styles** (component props)
   - May override all CSS

**Consequence:** Grid column spanning NEVER happens because no rule targets the correct elements with `grid-column: 1 / -1`

## The Hero Buttons Issue

### Expected Behavior
```css
/* landing-shared.css should define: */
.landing-hero-content > .landing-hero-buttons {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;  /* FULL WIDTH */
  margin-top: 1rem;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 1rem;
}
```

### Actual Behavior
**landing-shared.css line 125** has:
```css
.landing-hero-content > div:last-child {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
  margin-top: 1rem;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 1rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
```

**Why This Fails:**
1. `:last-child` is fragile - works only if buttons are literally last element
2. Overly generic - matches ANY last div
3. `div:last-child` has specificity `0,1,2` while `.landing-hero-buttons` has specificity `0,1,0`
4. If buttons div is not last (e.g., some other div added after), selector breaks

**In LandingAWS.jsx:** Structure is correct, buttons ARE last child, so `:last-child` works by accident
**But:** Better to use explicit `.landing-hero-buttons` selector

## Page-Specific CSS Problem

Every `/src/pages/Landing*.css` file redefines what's ALREADY in landing-shared.css:

### Duplication Pattern Example

**landing-shared.css (generic rules):**
```css
.breadcrumb-nav a {
  color: var(--primary-color);
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: color 0.2s ease;
  font-weight: 500;
}
```

**LandingAWS.css (hardcoded for AWS):**
```css
.breadcrumb-nav a {
  color: #ff9800;  /* HARDCODED, not using variable */
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: color 0.2s ease;
  font-weight: 500;
}
```

**Same specificity:** `0,2,0`
**Last rule wins:** LandingAWS.css applies
**Problem:** Duplicated 500+ lines across 20 files

## Selector Cascade for Elements in Hero

### Hero Title H1

```
Cascade Order (Lowest to Highest Specificity):
1. landing-shared.css:77    .landing-hero-content > h1 { ... }         [0,1,1] - NO MATCH
2. landing-shared.css:87    .hero-text h1 { ... }                      [0,1,1] - NO MATCH
3. landing-hero-text.css:12 .landing-hero-text .landing-hero-title {..} [0,2,1] - MATCH ✓ WINNER
4. LandingAWS.css:56        .hero-text h1 { ... }                      [0,1,1] - NO MATCH
```

**Applied rule:** landing-hero-text.css
**Problem:** No grid-column definition in the winning rule

4. LandingAWS.css:64        .hero-subtitle { ... }                      [0,1,0] - MAYBE MATCH

| Element | Should Have | Currently Has | Missing From |
|---------|------------|---------------|----|
| Hero Title H1 | `grid-column: 1 / -1` | (nothing) | landing-hero-text.css or selector needs adding to landing-shared.css |

| Hero Buttons Div | `grid-column: 1 / -1` | (nothing) | .landing-hero-buttons needs explicit rule in landing-shared.css |

## Quick Selector Reference

### Old (Non-Functional) Selectors
These are defined in landing-shared.css but DON'T match the component output:
```css
.landing-hero-content > h1              /* ❌ components render h1 inside .landing-hero-text */
.landing-hero-content > .hero-subtitle  /* ❌ components render p inside .landing-hero-text */
.hero-text h1                           /* ❌ no .hero-text element created */
.hero-cta                               /* ❌ no .hero-cta element created, use .landing-hero-buttons */
```

### New (Correct) Selectors
These match the actual component output:
```css
.landing-hero-content > .landing-hero-text      /* ✓ matches component container */
.landing-hero-text .landing-hero-title          /* ✓ matches h1 inside */
.landing-hero-text .landing-hero-subtitle       /* ✓ matches subtitle p */
.landing-hero-text .landing-hero-description    /* ✓ matches description p */
.landing-hero-content > .hero-icon              /* ✓ matches icon container */
.landing-hero-content > .landing-hero-buttons   /* ✓ matches buttons container */
```
